posts.text: image 757×288 34.3 KB UJJIVAN Small Finance Bank posted record Q1FY27 results NII is up 38.6% YoY, and PAT is up 207% YoY. Loan book and deposits grew, and asset quality improved. FY27 guidance targets 25% growth in advances and an RoA of 1.8–2.0%.
